note: Simit is named twice: once to argue that DSLs like Simit require rewriting entire simulations and lack cloud load-balancing/fault-tolerance (a limitation Nimbus addresses), and once to describe it as a DSL that Nimbus could target, explicitly differentiating Nimbus's approach from requiring a new data model or language.
title: Automatically Distributing Eulerian and Hybrid Fluid Simulations in the Cloud
